evidence.quote: < 200% of 100% discount off AGB 100% discount off BAI

tiers.description: Hospitals in states other than Colorado: 75% discount off AGB (uninsured) or off BAI (underinsured). Colorado hospitals: 75% discount for >250% to 300% FPL.
50% discount off AGB (uninsured) or off BAI (underinsured), for >300% to 400% FPL.

evidence.quote: (1) their household income is 400% of the FPL or less;

asset_test.details: Assets are not considered for the income-based discount. Only if a patient has no documented income or is not required to file taxes, BH may assess ability to pay by comparing debt to equity (liquid assets); a debt-to-equity ratio over 50% gets the Medically Indigent discount.

evidence.quote: Equity includes liquid assets (cash, stocks, bonds, and other assets that can be liquidated within 7 days) to cover outstanding bills.

presumptive_eligibility: Patients presumptively eligible based on household income need not apply and the Section III.C.i discounts are applied automatically.
how_to_apply: Get an application in person at a Hospital or from the BH website, or request one by mail by calling 1-888-264-2127; deliver or mail to the address on the application form or submit per BH website instructions.
warnings: Policy covers many hospitals in AZ, CO, NE, WY, and NV; Colorado hospitals have different thresholds: 100% discount at or below 250% FPL, 75% for >250% to 300%, and 50% for >300% to 400%. Free care and tier values extracted are for non-Colorado hospitals.
Non-Colorado free care band is stated as '< 200%' and the 75% band starts at '200%'.
Banner Lassen Medical Center (California) is excluded and governed by a separate policy (No. 3658).
Hospital state not given because the policy covers multiple states.
The 400% FPL limit applies to income-based assistance; Medically Indigent Household status can give a 75% discount at any income level (including above 400% FPL).
Application deadline not stated; the 120-day Notification Period before extraordinary collection actions is not an application deadline.
Discounts apply to uninsured and underinsured patients; the 'Underinsured' discount applies to the balance after insurance (BAI).
